data.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?

result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign** for simplicity and value, or **DocuSign** if you want a more established, widely recognised business solution.

However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, whether you need multiple staff members, and whether you want customers to sign contracts, quotes, proposals or onboarding documents.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Automatic reminders and signing notifications.
- Audit trails and signed PDF copies.
- Good for client agreements and service contracts.

Pricing: Entry plans around US\$15/month, depending on billing.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall business solution)

- Widely recognised by customers and businesses.
- Strong document workflows.
- Templates, reminders and signing order.
- Extensive third-party integrations.
- Good as your business grows.

Pricing: Entry plans around US\$11–15/month.

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional-looking proposals.
- Build quotes and contracts.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Useful for sales-focused businesses.

Pricing: Free limited plan; paid plans from around US\$19/user/month.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Sign**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable for small teams.
- Document templates and automated workflows.
- Audit trails and signing reminders.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.

Pricing: Free tier available; paid plans around US\$10/user/month.

[Zoho Sign website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

---

![Annature](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ajDlQ4iEQSWiUrNSiiYa3PBzbS3E9LMmDFEF5w0gC4YywypR_OfCZzcQHGxmJ93Bw6W3kdLOStVGOC-XwiIfrfKAb-cJF-VTKTaiR_YKNe2-JEBWth8EYs4f7BuBWLrJPCGttgYvC70mNM3hL8x1nwdBtEahr-UR1AnN82qozDuJ_Y6oAVb82lBSb8Ghj0f5?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Annature**

(Best Australian-focused option)

- Designed for Australian businesses.
- Electronic signing and document workflows.
- Australian data-hosting option.
- Worth considering when local data residency matters.

Pricing: Published pricing starts around A\$1.75 per envelope.

[Annature website](https://www.annature.com.au/)

## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and signatures | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional business solution | DocuSign |
| Quotes and sales proposals | PandaDoc |
| Keeping costs low | Zoho Sign |
| Australian data residency | Annature |


One important consideration in Australia: check that the platform provides suitable identity verification, signing evidence and audit trails for the types of agreements you use. Not every document can necessarily be signed electronically under the same rules.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
